label: Note
description: A note beside a run: the text an author gives, and the site that gave it, kept where the test can read them.

record.description: Keep the text with the site it came from. The site is the compiler's: where this node is, in the author's words.

site.description: where this call was written; the compiler fills it and the note carries it

watch.description: Keep the site a startup step names this from, and hold nothing that needs stopping: a `holds` operation a step may name.

site.description: the step this was named from; the compiler fills it
